title: Bertrand's Paradox (with 3blue1brown) - Numberphile
summary: Numberphile interviews Grant Sanderson of 3blue1brown about Bertrand's paradox, where different reasonable ways of picking a random chord of a circle give different probabilities.
why: Cited in threads on random sampling as a clear illustration of how reasonable-sounding random choices can give biased results.

quote.text: there's a Numberphile / 3B1B video about the pitfalls of plotting randomness in a circle
